critical_input_correction.problem: The historical internal state_units measure treats a literal occurrence as one unit and therefore does not by itself charge the bit length of arbitrarily large variable identifiers.
critical_input_correction.repair: Before theorem-mode accounting, densely relabel sorted source variables v_1<...<v_n to 1,...,n. Preserve the inverse map only for optional witness presentation.
critical_input_correction.effect: All internal variable identifiers then have O(log N) bit length; internal unit accounting is polynomially dominated by ordinary encoded input length.

derived_invariants.statement: For normalized input size N>=2, root state_units < N <= N^2, so ROOT_EXCEEDS_FIXED_CAP is unreachable.

Every retained residual has state_units <= N^2: restriction/unit propagation does not increase the represented CNF; capped elimination rejects before retaining an over-cap result; v2/v3 macro plans are admitted only when every required intermediate/result is <= N^2.
There are at most N root variables and at most N admitted historical extension variables, hence every reachable live variable set is contained in a universe of size <=2N.
Every admitted Stage4 macro allocates exactly one fresh extension and extension_count is capped by N, so successful Stage4 macro count <=N.

With n=root variable count <=N and kmax=N, initial phi=n*(n+N+2)<=2N^2+2N. Unit propagation with a genuine unit removes at least one live variable; pure elimination is admitted only with strict phi decrease; v2/v3 macro plans are admitted only with strict phi decrease. Therefore the number of state-changing outer-loop continuations before SAT/UNSAT/OPEN is O(N^2).

coarse_deterministic_work_bound.model: Paper-level deterministic implementation using sorted vectors/balanced dictionaries; the Python reference implementation is an executable reference, not a worst-case hash-table complexity proof.
facts: Residual clause count and literal occurrences are <=N^2 and live variable universe <=2N.
The number of distinct co-occurring OR-pair candidates is O(N^3): sum_c binom(width(c),2) <= O(max_width * total_literal_occurrences) with max_width<=2N.

One capped resolution elimination examines at most O(N^4) parent pairs; deterministic clause merge/canonical handling adds at most an O(N) literal factor, giving a conservative O(N^5) bound per attempted pivot replay.
v2 root-restore discovery has O(N^3) macro candidates and O(N) root pivots per candidate, hence is bounded by a fixed polynomial (coarsely O(N^9) including replay/canonical overhead).

v3 extension-tail discovery has O(N^3) macro candidates and O(N^2) ordered old-pivot pairs per candidate, hence is bounded by a fixed polynomial (coarsely O(N^10) including replay/canonical overhead).

For fixed resolution width 3 over <=2N variables, the universe of possible width<=3 clauses is O(N^3). Naive deterministic saturation needs at most O(N^3) growth passes and O(N^6) pair comparisons per pass, hence O(N^9) per call.

2-SAT, bounded-width affine recovery (MAX_SCOPE_WIDTH=8), relation-product recognition, component decomposition, Hall recognition, and one-variable nonrecursive escape are all fixed-polynomial on an N^2-bounded residual.
coarse_deterministic_work_bound.conservative_total_bound: Combining an O(N^10) conservative per-state discovery bound with O(N^2) strict-progress states gives O(N^12) word/literal operations; after dense relabeling, an extra logarithmic bit factor can be absorbed into O(N^13) bit operations. This is intentionally loose and should be tightened in a formal machine model before publication.
coarse_deterministic_work_bound.claim: The frozen capped engine can be implemented as a deterministic polynomial-time exact partial SAT decider returning SAT, UNSAT, or OPEN.

decision_vs_witness_correction.problem: The current executable may return OPEN after an already exact SAT terminal condition solely because local witness reconstruction/lift failed.
decision_vs_witness_correction.theorem_repair: The P-vs-NP theorem core is a decision algorithm. Exact SAT terminal truth must return SAT in DECISION_CORE even if an optional local witness lift fails. Once a polynomial SAT decider is universal, a source assignment is recoverable by standard polynomial self-reduction.

finite_full_trajectory_evidence.scientific_boundary: Finite success is falsification evidence only and does not establish universal totality.

remaining_central_theorem.name: REACHABLE_MOVE_OR_TERMINAL_TOTALITY
remaining_central_theorem.statement: For every densely normalized CNF phi and every nonterminal state reachable by the one frozen theorem-mode JANUS algorithm under the original root budget N, before resource caps are exhausted, at least one exact admitted terminal lane or exact strict-progress transition is available; equivalently the decision core never returns OPEN.
remaining_central_theorem.equivalent_failure_target: Exhibit one reachable state satisfying the frozen root-relative resource invariants for which every terminal lane, capped exact elimination, v2 root-restore plan, and v3 extension-tail plan rejects, or prove no such reachable state exists.

premises: dense input normalization exact and polynomial
theorem_consequence_if_closed.conclusion: The OPEN outcome is unreachable, so the fixed algorithm decides SAT for every CNF in polynomial time. Hence SAT is in P and, because SAT is NP-complete, P=NP.

next_action: Implement the decision-core/witness split, then attack REACHABLE_MOVE_OR_TERMINAL_TOTALITY directly with an exact structural proof attempt and hostile counterexample search under the frozen grammar.
